cell_line.evidence: Using CRISPR-Cas9, we generated a homozygous knock-in mutant in Jurkat cells and investigated its effects on ribosome biogenesis.

disease_state.evidence: Somatic mutations in ribosomal proteins (RPs), including RPL5, have been reported in approximately 10 % of pediatric patients with T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia (T-ALL).
